## Specific task description

Adjacent block centers are nearly aligned horizontally, with vertical separation approximately one block height. Both grippers are open and have released the blocks.

## Execution tips

- Grip flat upper-middle regions of opposite block faces, avoiding corners and ensuring full pad contact while leaving placement clearance underneath. Open only slightly wider than the separation of the grasped faces.
- The blocks have different tabletop rotations. Orient the gripper to their actual sides and confirm opposing finger positions before closing, avoiding image overlap that results in one-sided or corner contact.
- Use the open area at the front and center of the table to adjust pose. During transport, ensure the block bottom and fingertips are clear of the table and blocks along the route to reduce the risk of hitting containers and ornaments behind them.
- When placing the upper block, align horizontally above the lower top face first, then lower vertically and slowly. Avoid pushing it sideways after contact, which could move the existing stack.
- Before release, confirm the block is securely supported. Keep the gripper steady as it opens, then withdraw upward to avoid dropping it while suspended or knocking it over with a sideways pull.
